samples.summary: Read-only note mounts no longer publish caret presence to peers — a behaviour change at an out-of-diff consumer of the store handle
samples.evidence: `initialize()` now hands every plugin the wrapped store (`packages/notes/src/view/editor.ts:249`), and `readOnlyNoteStore` neuters `setLocalSelection` (`packages/notes/src/store/read-only.ts:~150`, 'setLocalSelection is included deliberately'). `NoteRemoteSelectionsPluginValue.update()` at packages/notes/src/view/remote-selection.ts:170-172 is the sole caller: before this change a viewer-role share-link mount published its selection through the raw `YorkieNoteStore`, so editors saw the viewer's caret; now it is silently dropped. Nothing in the notes design doc (docs/design/notes/notes.md) or any test records that a viewer's caret disappears for peers, and the change is invisible in the diff because the call site was not touched.

samples.summary: notes-settings' module doc still says the shared read-only viewer does not use these preferences; SharedNotesLayout now reads all three
samples.evidence: packages/frontend/src/app/notes/notes-settings.ts:6-7: "The owner editor (NotesDetail) reads them on open and writes them on change; the read-only shared viewer does not use them." The new packages/frontend/src/app/shared/shared-notes-layout.tsx:8-12 imports `readKeymap`, `readShowAuthors`, `readViewMode` and seeds the share-link mount (viewer included) from them. The comment is the only statement of the read/write contract for this module and now describes the old one.

samples.summary: User documentation still tells readers a share-linked note has no view menu and no Show-authors switch
samples.evidence: packages/documentation/notes/writing-a-note.md:85-86: "Like the view mode, the switch is remembered per browser. It isn't available in a note opened through a share link, which has no view menu." After this change `SharedNotesLayout` mounts `NotesToolbar` for both roles (shared-notes-layout.tsx:104-114), so the view menu and Show-authors switch ARE available on a share link — and, unlike the workspace route, changes there are deliberately not remembered per browser. Two statements in the shipped docs are now false.
searchedFor: grep 'no view menu|no toolbar|share-link mount' across repo

samples.summary: The docs package's twin wrapper still asserts the claim this diff explicitly repudiates ("this flag is the write boundary")
samples.evidence: packages/notes/src/store/read-only.ts:56-58 states "the earlier claim here that it was 'the write boundary' on a default install was wrong". The sibling it was copied from still makes exactly that claim: packages/docs/src/store/read-only.ts:38-42 ("…so with the default configuration this flag is the write boundary rather than a convenience in front of one"), and packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:4413 repeats it. Since the corrected reasoning is now the reviewed-for-security posture (and is what the backend controller's boot warning encodes), leaving the docs twin stating the opposite means the next reader of the docs editor gets the retracted rationale.

samples.summary: The share-token uploader handed to NotesView rejects on failure, but the notes engine's contract expects `null`-with-a-toast, so an anonymous editor's failed image upload is silent
samples.evidence: `NotesViewProps.uploadImage` is documented as "resolve with … `null` if the upload failed and was already reported to the user" (packages/frontend/src/app/notes/notes-view.tsx:46-51), and the workspace route satisfies it by catching and toasting (notes-detail.tsx:208-231). `shareTokenImageUploader` instead propagates the rejection (packages/frontend/src/app/docs/image-insert.ts:40-49 → postShareTokenImage), and the engine's `beginUpload` turns a rejection into `console.error` + a removed placeholder only (packages/notes/src/view/image-upload.ts:179-190). Net effect on the new call site: a share-link editor whose paste/drop upload fails sees the placeholder vanish with no explanation. Fix belongs on the new code (wrap the uploader with a toast-and-return-null adapter).

samples.summary: Template gallery previews mount SharedDocumentByToken, so note-template previews now render the full notes toolbar (view menu, keymap picker) inside the gallery panel
samples.evidence: packages/frontend/src/app/templates/template-landing.tsx:174 and packages/frontend/src/app/templates/template-review-queue.tsx:136 both render `<SharedDocumentByToken token={…} />`, which routes a `type === "note"` template through the new `SharedNotesLayout` (shared-document.tsx:1002). These two surfaces previously got a bare header + editor; they now get a 40-ish-px toolbar strip with a keymap picker and Show-authors switch inside a preview panel that was sized for chrome-less content. Neither call site was updated or considered in the diff; I could not confirm from source how the preview container sizes itself, hence low confidence on the visual impact.
